exact_claim.priority: the first efficient algorithm for differentially private range subgraph counting
exact_claim.metric: maximum absolute error over q in Q
exact_claim.efficiency_scope: polynomial time for d = O(log n / log log n)

acceptance: A proof-level privacy, utility, and complexity certificate for the named algorithm plus a defensible priority audit; finite error observations alone cannot establish the asymptotic theorem.
reason: The exact source contract is machine-checked, but privacy/utility proof dependencies and the priority claim have not been independently discharged.
